title: Minimal asymmetric tool access
description: Two-actor declaration that creates a reason to interact around tool access without prescribing trust, exchange, or cooperation. Step C1 schema example only; the C2 scenario files are separate.

asymmetries.description: One actor begins nearer useful woodworking tools or crafting capacity; the other has gathering pressure without equivalent access.
asymmetries.subject: wooden_tools_or_crafting_access

nodes.title: Gather logs
nodes.description: Collect logs from the natural world.

nodes.title: Access tools
nodes.description: Use or obtain tools that make gathering or crafting more efficient.

edges.description: Tool access can change gathering efficiency without requiring any particular social response.

required_capabilities.gap_reason: The case exists in the capability manifest, but no current-run normalized capability report has been approved for this scenario declaration.
No current-run craft_table capability report is required for this C1 declaration example; C2 may attach resolved evidence.

interaction_opportunities.description: Actors may observe each other near asymmetric tool access and choose to request, offer, ignore, or work alone.

material_stakes.description: Possession or temporary access to a useful tool changes another actor's available options.

provenance.notes: Minimal valid C1 declaration. TODO(C2): expand into economic/cooperative/quest families.
